newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt state offers 24.5 pct of tourism company.
newsitem.headline: Egypt state offers 24.5 pct of tourism company.

text.p: An Egyptian state-owned company said on Tuesday it was offering private investors and institutions 5,142 shares in subsidiary the Egyptian Company for Touristic and Entertainment Projects (Tulip).

An official at the government-owned Housing, Tourism, and Cinema holding company said the shares represented 24.5 percent of Tulip and they have a nominal value of 1,000 pounds. He did not give an offer price for the stock.
The offer, part of the government's privatisation-led economic reform programme, will be open for one day on August 2.
The holding company said in a published announcement it had set up Tulip to promote tourism, as well as create leisure facilities such as golf courses and five star hotels.
